stories.title: Integrate SAP S/4HANA planning data into RapidResponse
stories.i_want: SAP S/4HANA supply planning data loaded into Kinaxis RapidResponse
stories.so_that: I can plan using a single aligned source of inventory, supply, demand, and planning parameter data
acceptance_criteria: Given SAP S/4HANA is the source system, When the data integration is executed, Then RapidResponse loads on-hand inventory, planned receipts, demand forecasts, supply orders, bills of material, part-source data, constraints, and planning parameters.

Given data is loaded from SAP S/4HANA, When a planner reviews a part-site record in RapidResponse, Then the record displays the associated inventory, supply, demand, and planning attributes required for Phase 1 Supply Management.
Given an integration load completes, When load results are reviewed, Then success and exception counts are available for each major data object loaded from SAP S/4HANA.
stories.section_source: Section 1.3 Scope; Section 1.2 Current State of Business

stories.title: Configure Archlin supply chain sites in RapidResponse
stories.i_want: to configure distribution, manufacturing, and virtual sites with required attributes
stories.so_that: Archlin's specialty chemicals supply chain network can be represented accurately in RapidResponse
acceptance_criteria: Given a site is created in RapidResponse, When the site record is saved, Then it includes Site Name, Country using ISO Alpha-2 code, Currency, ERP Instance ID, and Type.
Given a site is configured, When the Type is selected, Then the allowed values are Distribution, Manufacturing, or Virtual.
Given Archlin sites are available for planning, When planners view the supply chain network, Then manufacturing sites, distribution sites, and virtual sites are distinguishable by site type.

stories.title: Model material and supply flows across Archlin sites
stories.i_want: RapidResponse to model site linkages, bills of material, and demand/supply transfer paths
stories.so_that: I can understand how demand and supply flow across the specialty chemicals manufacturing network
acceptance_criteria: Given distribution and manufacturing sites are configured, When network relationships are maintained, Then RapidResponse represents links between distribution locations and manufacturing facilities.
Given a manufacturing site produces make parts, When bills of material are loaded, Then component-to-finished-good relationships are visible for planning.
Given demand or supply is transferred between nodes, When a planner reviews the network model, Then the source site, destination site, and material flow path are visible.

stories.title: View period ending inventory by value and volume
stories.i_want: visibility of period ending inventory in both value and volume across Archlin sites
stories.so_that: I can monitor inventory positions and improve inventory planning discipline
acceptance_criteria: Given inventory data and planning projections are available, When I open the period ending inventory view, Then I can see projected inventory by period in both value and volume.
Given inventory is displayed, When I filter by site, product hierarchy, or planner responsibility, Then the inventory values and volumes update to reflect the selected filter.
Given inventory projections exist across the planning horizon, When I select a future period, Then the projected period ending inventory value and volume are displayed for that period.

stories.title: Analyze inventory trends across the planning horizon
stories.i_want: to analyze inventory trends by product hierarchy, site, and planner responsibility
stories.so_that: I can identify inventory build-up or depletion patterns before they become exceptions
acceptance_criteria: Given period ending inventory projections are available, When I view inventory trends, Then inventory is displayed across multiple planning periods.
Given inventory trends are displayed, When I group results by product hierarchy, site, or planner responsibility, Then the trend values aggregate according to the selected grouping.
Given historical inventory data is available, When I compare projected inventory to historical patterns, Then the view displays both actual or historical values and projected values for comparison.

stories.title: Define and maintain inventory targets
stories.i_want: to define and adjust inventory targets for ending inventory, minimum stock, maximum stock, and periods of supply
stories.so_that: inventory exceptions can be identified against agreed planning thresholds
acceptance_criteria: Given a part, site, or product hierarchy level is selected, When I maintain inventory targets, Then I can enter ending inventory target, minimum stock, maximum stock, minimum periods of supply, and maximum periods of supply.
Given targets are saved, When inventory projections are recalculated or refreshed, Then the targets are used to evaluate inventory exceptions.
Given a target is updated, When the change is saved, Then the updated target value is visible for the applicable part, site, hierarchy level, and effective period.

stories.title: Maintain time-phased inventory target profiles
stories.i_want: to maintain time-phased inventory targets
stories.so_that: inventory planning can reflect seasonality in specialty chemicals demand
acceptance_criteria: Given a target profile is created, When I assign effective periods, Then different target values can be maintained for different time periods.
Given time-phased targets exist, When a planner reviews inventory for a selected period, Then the target value effective for that period is used.
Given a seasonal target profile is updated, When the changes are saved, Then future-period exception calculations use the updated seasonal thresholds.

stories.title: Configure Inventory Quality Ratio classifications
stories.i_want: to configure definitions of active, excess, slow-moving, and obsolete inventory
stories.so_that: Archlin can measure inventory quality consistently for specialty chemicals products
acceptance_criteria: Given IQR configuration is available, When I define inventory classifications, Then active, excess, slow-moving, and obsolete categories can be maintained.
Given classification rules are configured, When inventory is evaluated, Then each applicable inventory record is classified according to the configured IQR definitions.
Given IQR results are calculated, When I review inventory quality, Then I can see the percentage of active inventory compared with excess, slow-moving, and obsolete inventory.

stories.title: Monitor Inventory Quality Ratio metrics and trends
stories.i_want: to monitor Inventory Quality Ratio metrics against targets over time
stories.so_that: I can identify deteriorating inventory positions before they negatively impact working capital
acceptance_criteria: Given inventory quality classifications are calculated, When I open the IQR dashboard, Then I can view IQR metrics by period.
Given corporate IQR targets are maintained, When I review IQR performance, Then actual IQR values are compared against target values.
Given multiple periods are available, When I view IQR trends, Then I can identify whether active, excess, slow-moving, or obsolete inventory is increasing or decreasing over time.

stories.title: Detect inventory exceptions against targets
stories.i_want: RapidResponse to identify parts with inventory levels above or below targets
stories.so_that: I can proactively manage inventory exceptions instead of relying on manual spreadsheet analysis
acceptance_criteria: Given inventory projections and targets are available, When exception detection runs, Then parts with period ending inventory below minimum or above maximum thresholds are flagged.
Given periods of supply thresholds are maintained, When inventory is evaluated, Then parts below minimum periods of supply or above maximum periods of supply are identified.
Given inventory exceptions are generated, When I review the exception list, Then each exception includes part, site, period, target value, projected value, and deviation.

stories.title: Prioritize inventory exceptions
stories.i_want: to prioritize inventory exceptions by value, service impact, and deviation magnitude
stories.so_that: I can focus first on the exceptions with the highest business impact
acceptance_criteria: Given inventory exceptions are available, When I sort or filter the exception list, Then I can prioritize by inventory value, service level impact, and deviation magnitude.
Given an exception has projected customer or revenue impact, When the exception is displayed, Then the service or revenue impact is visible to support prioritization.
Given multiple exceptions exist, When I apply filters by site, product family, or planner code, Then only exceptions matching the selected criteria are displayed.

stories.title: Identify slow-moving, excess, and obsolete inventory
stories.i_want: visibility of slow-moving, excess, and obsolete inventories by period across Archlin's network
stories.so_that: I can reduce working capital exposure and support write-down decisions
acceptance_criteria: Given aging, demand, and classification criteria are configured, When inventory is evaluated, Then slow-moving, excess, and obsolete inventory positions are identified.
Given classified inventory exists, When I review the inventory quality view, Then I can see slow-moving, excess, and obsolete inventory by period, part, site, and value.
Given excess or obsolete inventory is identified, When I drill into the record, Then I can review details supporting the classification.

stories.title: Analyze root causes of excess and obsolete inventory
stories.i_want: to analyze root causes contributing to excess and obsolete inventory positions
stories.so_that: I can determine appropriate corrective actions
acceptance_criteria: Given an excess or obsolete inventory record is selected, When I open the analysis view, Then the related demand, supply, inventory, and classification details are displayed.

Given supporting planning data exists, When I analyze the exception, Then I can identify whether the position is associated with demand reduction, aging inventory, excess supply, or lack of future demand.
Given root-cause analysis is completed, When I document the finding, Then the reason and recommended action are retained with the inventory exception.

stories.title: Identify stockouts and expected recovery dates
stories.i_want: to see parts currently out of stock and their expected recovery dates
stories.so_that: I can prioritize stockout resolution and communicate supply recovery expectations
acceptance_criteria: Given on-hand inventory is available, When a part-site has zero stock, Then the part-site is flagged as a stockout.
Given a stockout has planned supply receipts, When I review the stockout record, Then the expected recovery date is calculated from the planned receipt date that restores inventory availability.
Given stockout records are displayed, When I review demand impact, Then demand at risk is visible for the affected part-site.

stories.title: Prioritize stockouts by revenue and customer impact
stories.i_want: to prioritize stockout resolution based on revenue and customer impact
stories.so_that: I can address the most critical service risks first
acceptance_criteria: Given stockout records exist, When revenue impact is available, Then stockouts display projected late revenue or revenue at risk.
Given customer impact data is available, When I review stockouts, Then the affected demand or customer impact is visible.
Given multiple stockouts exist, When I sort the stockout list, Then I can rank stockouts by projected late revenue, recovery date, and demand at risk.

stories.title: Simulate inventory transfers between sites
stories.i_want: to simulate transferring inventory from another Archlin site
stories.so_that: I can evaluate whether a transfer can resolve projected late orders before execution
acceptance_criteria: Given a projected late order or inventory shortage exists, When I select a source site with available inventory, Then I can create a simulated inventory transfer to the destination site.
Given a simulated transfer is created, When the scenario is recalculated, Then the impact on projected late orders and destination inventory is updated.
Given the source site inventory is used in the simulation, When I review source site impacts, Then the remaining inventory and any new source-site exceptions are displayed.

stories.title: Simulate write-down, on-hand adjustment, and inventory type changes
stories.i_want: to simulate write-downs, physical count corrections, and inventory type classification changes
stories.so_that: I can evaluate corrective actions for excess, obsolete, or inaccurate inventory positions
acceptance_criteria: Given excess or obsolete inventory is selected, When I simulate a write-down or disposal quantity, Then the scenario reduces the applicable inventory quantity and value.
Given a physical count correction is required, When I simulate an on-hand inventory adjustment, Then the scenario updates the inventory quantity for the selected part and site.

Given inventory is assigned a type such as available, quarantine, or obsolete, When I simulate an inventory type change, Then the scenario reflects the new inventory classification without updating SAP S/4HANA directly.

stories.title: Analyze scenario impact on inventory KPIs
stories.i_want: to compare simulated inventory adjustment scenarios against key inventory KPIs
stories.so_that: I can choose the best resolution strategy before submitting changes for execution
acceptance_criteria: Given one or more simulated inventory adjustment scenarios exist, When I run impact analysis, Then the scenario displays impacts to on-time line by due date, period ending inventory value, periods of supply, order issues, inventory exceptions, late demand, projected late revenue, excess value, and obsolete value.
Given impact results are displayed, When I filter by part, site, or product hierarchy, Then KPI results update to reflect the selected scope.
Given multiple scenarios exist, When I compare scenarios, Then KPI differences are shown so planners can evaluate alternative resolution strategies.

stories.title: Collaborate on inventory exception resolution
stories.i_want: to collaborate with other planners and document assumptions for inventory exceptions
stories.so_that: resolution actions and ownership are clear across supply planning teams
acceptance_criteria: Given an inventory exception is selected, When I create a collaboration item, Then I can assign an owner and document the proposed action or planning assumption.
Given a collaboration item exists, When users update comments or status, Then the updates are retained with the related inventory exception.
Given an exception has assigned actions, When I review the exception, Then current owner, status, comments, and action history are visible.

stories.title: Support manual closed-loop execution into SAP S/4HANA
stories.i_want: to capture approved inventory adjustments for manual entry into SAP S/4HANA
stories.so_that: planning decisions made in RapidResponse can be executed through Archlin's system of record
acceptance_criteria: Given a simulated inventory adjustment is approved, When the planner marks it for execution, Then the adjustment is captured in a consolidated workbook or action list.
Given approved adjustments are captured, When the action list is reviewed, Then each record includes part, site, adjustment type, quantity or value, target date, owner, and approval status.
Given an adjustment is manually entered into SAP S/4HANA, When the planner updates the action record, Then the execution status and audit trail are retained in RapidResponse.
